title: I CAN DO Surgical ACP
official: I CAN DO Surgical ACP (Improving Completion, Accuracy, and Dissemination of Surgical Advanced Care Planning) Trial
summary: The goal of the Advanced Care Planning (ACP) study is to encourage patients aged 65 or older who are referred for elective surgery to have advanced care planning.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Older Adults (age 65+) referred for surgical evaluation

Exclusion Criteria:

1. ACP on file within 3 years prior to surgery (UCSF and UCI) and 5 years (UMN)
2. Was previously randomized into intervention for a prior surgery during the 18-month study period
